WITH per_patient_avg AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) as patient_avg
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ID
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(patient_avg) as avg_value
  FROM per_patient_avg
),
kept_patients AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.patient_avg
  FROM per_patient_avg p
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
  WHERE p.patient_avg > o.avg_value
),
kept_patients_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(patient_avg) as kept_avg
  FROM kept_patients
)
SELECT 
  k.ID,
  k.patient_avg,
  k.patient_avg - o.avg_value as above_overall,
  k.patient_avg - km.kept_avg as above_kept_mean
FROM kept_patients k
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
CROSS JOIN kept_patients_mean km
ORDER BY above_kept_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
